name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 22, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Senior Pastor Bob Kennedy of Oak Hills Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of Letter of Appreciation to Amigos de Vista Lions Club.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending July 31, 2009 (CC)
C4.
Unscheduled Vacancy on the Parks and Recreation Commission (CC)
C5.
Appointing Alternates to the Investment Advisory Committee (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the appointment of alternates to the Investment Advisory Committee; and
2.
Appoint Councilwoman Judy Ritter as the City Council alternate to the Investment Advisory Committee.
C6.
Cricket Communications Lease Agreement for Vista Botanical Gardens at Brengle Terrace Park (CC)
C7.
Traffic Impact Fee Deferral for Sonic Drive-In Restaurant (CC)
C8.
Grapevine Road Street Easement Purchases (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an acquisition agreement with Ruben S. Trejo and Madaline B. Trejo, as Trustees of the Trejo Family Trusts, for the purchase of a Public Street & Utility Easement at 705-713 Grapevine Road;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an acquisition agreement with Leigh E. Coppock and Bonnye M. Coppock, Co-Trustees of the Coppock Family Trust, for the purchase of a Public Street & Utility Easement at 727 Grapevine Road,
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an acquisition agreement with Edward Michael Vidaurri for the purchase of a Public Street & Utility Easement at 657 Grapevine Road; and (Recommended Action continued on following page)
(Recommended Action continued from previous page)
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an acquisition agreement with John McConnaughay and Judith Salkind, Trustees of the John McConnaughay and Judith Salkind Living Trust, for the purchase of a Public Street & Utility Easement at 719 Grapevine Road.
C9.
Agua Hedionda Creek Restoration Project Design Services (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with Tory R. Walker Engineering for preliminary engineering design services on the Agua Hedionda Creek Restoration Project;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a cost-sharing agreement with Buena Sanitation District; and
3.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , approving a cost-sharing agreement with the City of Vista.
C10.
Watson Way to Green Oak Road Sewer Upsize and Realignment Project (BSD)
C11.
Installation of All Way Stop for Coventry Road at Girard Way (CC)
C12.
No Parking Zone on E. Vista Way at Franklin Lane (CC)
C13.
North County Dispatch Joint Powers Authority Agreement (CC)
C14.
Agreement with ARC of San Diego for Grounds Keeping and Custodial Services for Brengle Terrace Park (CC)
C15.
Land Acquisition - Purchase of 325 S. Santa Fe Avenue (CDC)
1.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , approving a purchase and sales agreement for the property located at 325 S. Santa Fe Avenue, and authorizing the Chairperson to execute the agreement; and
2.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Operating Program Budget for the 2009/10 Fiscal Year.
C16.
Disadvantaged Business Enterprise Program (DBE) (CC)
C17.
RDA Financing Process - Subordination of Payments Under Existing Pass-Through Agreements (CDC)
C18.
Prohibiting Tobacco Use in City Parks, on Trails, and Outside of the Wave Waterpark, the Vista Library, and the Civic Center (CC)
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 12, Chapter 12.08, Section 12.08.010.AA of the Municipal Code to Prohibit Tobacco and Tobacco-Related Products in City Parks and Trails;" and (Recommended Action continued on following page)
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 8, Chapter 8.12, Section 8.12.020.e of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Smoking in Public Places."
DISCUSSION
D1.
Award of Contract for Street Resurfacing and Maintenance Project (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Amendment to Specific Plan No. 26, Regency Centers, Applicant (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the Specific Plan amendment, close the public hearing; and
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Approving an Amendment to Specific Plan No. 26 to Modify the Permitted Uses within the CV-1 Subzone to Allow a Total of 2,500 Square Feet of Medical Office Space."
PH2.
Amendment to Historic Preservation Ordinance (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding a proposed amendment to Chapter 15.12 of the Development Code, close the public hearing;
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 15.12 of the Development code Relating to Historic Preservation"; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , establishing fees for the processing of historical designation reviews.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
